newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romania cen.bank one-week rate jumps to 58.4 pct.
newsitem.headline: Romania cen.bank one-week rate jumps to 58.4 pct.

text.p: The National Bank of Romania (BNR) one-week refinancing rate soared to 58.4 percent from last week's 52.75 percent under heavy pressure from two major banks hungry for lei funds.
Two banks bid a total of 725 billion lei at rates ranging from 55 to 59 percent for the available 500 billion lei.
The central bank offered 100 billion lei extra funds at Thursday's auction but kept its minimum permitted rate unchanged at 49 percent. -- Bucharest Newsroom 40-1 3120264
